name: When should I repair my siding versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair my siding versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: If only a few panels are damaged, and the majority of your siding is in good condition, repair is generally the most cost-effective option. However, if there's widespread damage, significant deterioration across multiple sections, or if your siding is nearing the end of its lifespan, a full replacement might be more economical in the long run. A professional assessment can help you make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose repair for isolated damage and good overall siding condition. Consider full replacement for widespread damage, significant deterioration, or if siding is at end-of-life.
